Do you still remember the feeling of driving away from the driveway on your own for the very first time? That feeling is pure freedom. But for your parents, it was probably one of the most terrifying moments of their lives. When you were a teenager, your parents had absolutely no way of knowing whether you were speeding, when you would arrive at your destination, or how safe the drive was. No news was good news, and until you checked in with them, "hope" was the only real tool they had.

If you currently have a teen driver, you should count yourself lucky, because the unknown fears your parents' generation faced are no longer the world you have to deal with today. 2026 technology certainly brings plenty of downsides, but HeyPolo is a perfect example of how technology has made life better and safer for teen drivers.

HeyPolo is absolutely not just a paid version of Apple's "Find My" service.

HeyPolo is a family safety app that combines real-time location sharing, arrival and departure alerts, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all in one subscription. The driving features are exactly what set it apart from basic location-sharing apps like Apple "Find My." Every time your teen driver heads out, the trip is recorded and scored, and you can see every detail: how fast they were going, whether they were using their phone while driving, any hard braking or rapid acceleration, and whether any serious driving incidents were detected.

The "Driving Score" rates each trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you no longer have to guess whether your son or daughter is really driving safely. You can look at the data, have a serious conversation with them if their performance is not up to standard, and watch the score gradually improve as their driving habits get better. Compared with anything available to the previous generation, this is a far more practical way to actually help new licence-holders improve.

Crash detection, arrival alerts and more — everything you need is included.

HeyPolo can detect a crash and automatically notify you. Combined with the arrival alert feature — which automatically triggers when your son or daughter arrives at school, practice, a friend's home, or back at the house — you move from the old passive waiting of "no news is good news" to actually knowing whether they are safe. You no longer have to wait for them to send a message or call you after they arrive; you will know exactly when they get there, and that peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo's location updates every 5 seconds, so their position is always accurate.

One subscription covers the whole family.

A single HeyPolo subscription covers your entire family, with absolutely no per-person fees on top. It works seamlessly on both iPhone and Android, so households with a mix of devices have no problem at all. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, which means it is backed by extremely robust privacy infrastructure. They will not sell your data, you have full control over what you share and with whom, when to stop sharing, and all data is deleted every 7 days. HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee with no lock-in contract, so you have absolutely no reason not to give it a try.
